results.name: KTO International spol sro
results.description: KTO International spol sro is a wholesale company operating in the Czech and Slovak Republics since 1992. The company is based in Trebechovice, Czechia. The company specializes in the distribution of heating systems, boilers, stoves, fireplaces, water heaters, accumulation tanks, radiators, copper, carbon steel and plastic piping systems, underfloor heating, metallurgical materials, pipe system accessories, insulation, fittings, industrial valves, expansion vessels and automatics, pumps, boiler distributors, solar systems, heat pumps and recuperation, cooling and air conditioning, measurement and regulation equipment, sanitary ceramics, showers, bathtubs, faucets, and related sanitary accessories. Wholesales building materials.
